spans.text: [30] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ EN: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

spans.text: [9] AR: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ EN: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything.

folded.id: a company|is|thrown into it

spans.text: Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

folded.id: and he|is|over all things competent -
folded.subject: and He

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

folded.id: and wretched|is|the destination
folded.subject: and wretched

spans.text: [6] AR: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

folded.id: and|we|have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze
folded.subject: And
folded.object: have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

spans.text: [5] AR: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

folded.subject: And
folded.object: will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

folded.subject: Do
folded.object: feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

spans.text: [16] AR: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ EN: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

folded.id: do|you|see any breaks?
folded.subject: do

spans.text: So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

folded.id: does he|who|created not know
folded.subject: Does He

spans.text: [14] AR: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

folded.id: for those|who|disbelieved in their lord is the punishment of hell
folded.subject: for those
folded.object: disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell

spans.text: [6] AR: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

folded.subject: have believed

spans.text: [29] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied.

folded.id: have persisted|in|insolence and aversion
folded.subject: have persisted

spans.text: But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

folded.id: have|you|considered: whether allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us
folded.subject: Have
folded.object: considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us

spans.text: [28] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

[30] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ EN: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

folded.id: he|is|knowing of that within the breasts
folded.subject: He
folded.object: Knowing of that within the breasts

spans.text: [13] AR: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ EN: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

folded.id: he|is|the most merciful
folded.subject: He

spans.text: [29] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied.

folded.id: if only|we|had been listening or reasoning
folded.subject: If only

spans.text: [10] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

folded.id: if you|should|be truthful?"
folded.subject: if you

spans.text: [25] AR: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

folded.id: it|is|he who has multiplied you throughout the earth
folded.subject: It
folded.object: He who has multiplied you throughout the earth

spans.text: [24] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

folded.id: it|is|he who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts
folded.subject: It
folded.object: He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts

spans.text: [23] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

folded.id: it|is|he who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of his provision - and to him is the resurrection
folded.subject: It
folded.object: He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection

spans.text: [15] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ EN: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

folded.id: little are|you|grateful
folded.subject: little are

spans.text: [23] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

folded.id: not but|in|delusion
folded.subject: not but

spans.text: The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

folded.id: not but|in|great error
folded.subject: not but

spans.text: You are not but in great error.'"

folded.id: not see|in|the creation of the most merciful any inconsistency
folded.subject: not see
folded.object: the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency

spans.text: You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency.

folded.id: or do|you|feel secure that he who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones?
folded.subject: Or do
folded.object: feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones?

spans.text: [17] AR: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ EN: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones?

folded.id: or who|is|it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the most merciful?
folded.subject: Or who
folded.object: it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful?

spans.text: [20] AR: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ EN: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful?

folded.id: or who|is|it that could provide for you if he withheld his provision?
folded.subject: Or who
folded.object: it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision?

spans.text: [21] AR: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ EN: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision?

folded.id: return to|you|humbled while it is fatigued
folded.subject: return to

spans.text: [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

folded.id: seven heavens|in|layers
folded.subject: seven heavens

spans.text: [3] AR: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ EN: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.

folded.id: the companions|of|the blaze
folded.subject: the companions

spans.text: [10] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
[11] AR: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

folded.id: the faces|of|those who disbelieve will be distressed
folded.subject: the faces
folded.object: those who disbelieve will be distressed

spans.text: [27] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ EN: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

folded.id: the knowledge|is|only with allah
folded.subject: The knowledge

spans.text: [26] AR: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

folded.id: then|is|one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

spans.text: [22] AR: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ EN: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

folded.id: then|who|could bring you flowing water?"
folded.subject: then

spans.text: [30] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ EN: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

folded.id: then|you|would know how [severe] was my warning
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: would know how [severe] was My warning

spans.text: Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

folded.id: this|is|that for which you used to call
folded.subject: This
folded.object: that for which you used to call

spans.text: [27] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ EN: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

folded.id: those|who|fear their lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward
folded.subject: those
folded.object: fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

spans.text: [12] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ EN: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

folded.id: to him|you|will be gathered
folded.subject: to Him

spans.text: [24] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

folded.id: to test|you|[as to] which of you is best in deed - and he is the exalted in might
folded.subject: to test
folded.object: [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might

spans.text: [2] AR: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ EN: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

folded.id: upon him|we|have relied
folded.subject: upon Him

spans.text: [29] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied.

folded.id: when|is|this promise
folded.subject: When

spans.text: [25] AR: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

folded.id: while he|is|the subtle
folded.subject: while He

spans.text: [14] AR: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
